Hosting and care is then ${CARE_LITE_AMOUNT} a month. The price is fixed and agreed in writing before we start.`, 102 }, 103 { 104 q: "How fast can you build my website?", 105 a: `On ${STARTER.name}: ${lcfirst(STARTER.timeline)}. On ${CUSTOM.name}, the timeline is ${lcfirst(CUSTOM.timeline)}.`, 106 }, 107 { 108 q: "Is there a lock-in contract?", 109 a: `On Starter, no. On Custom, care has a 12-month minimum, then runs month to month. Otherwise, care (${CARE_LITE_AMOUNT} a month) and the search plan (${perMonth(SEO_ONGOING)}) run month to month, and you can cancel either with 30 days' notice. ${OWNERSHIP_LINE}`, 110 }, 111 { 112 q: "How much does SEO cost per month?", 113 a: `A ${SEO_AUDIT} audit first, then ${perMonth(SEO_ONGOING)}, month to month. Other manual work you ask for beyond the plan: ${EXTRA_HOURLY_CLIENT} an hour (${EXTRA_HOURLY} without care or the plan), billed in 15-minute steps with a 30-minute minimum per job. Bigger jobs are priced and agreed in writing before we start.`, 120 }, 121 { 122 q: "Can I prepay, and what happens when I stop?", 123 a: `Prepay 6 months for ${SEO_ONGOING_6MO}, or 12 months for ${SEO_ONGOING_12MO}, in one payment, with everything in the plan included the whole way through.
